Platform › Egress

Egress

About this page

Every request an app sends outside the cluster goes through the egress proxy, on a port of the app's own, so the proxy knows which app is asking. A grant is a host the app may reach, per environment, held in each instance's record (grants.egress) and written there by swhurl-v2 edit --set egress=<host>, whose render carries it to this proxy. This page shows what the platform has rendered; it offers no form. A host without a grant is refused: the proxy answers 403 and logs granted=-. The last column opens that app's refused requests, the hosts it will need granted.
